data.name: Shivani
data.gender_notes: Shivani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shivani is a feminine form of Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and creation. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shivana', which means 'friendly to Shiva'. The name Shivani carries the meaning “Goddess Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shivani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shivani signifies devotion to Lord Shiva and embodies qualities such as grace, beauty, and strength.
data.etymology: Shivani belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivani total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
